stages.label: Dataset snapshot
stages.detail: Exact examples, splits, provenance, and risk labels.

stages.label: Run configuration
stages.detail: Application, prompt, model, tools, retrieval, and environment versions.

stages.label: Captured output
stages.detail: Responses, traces, latency, token use, and execution failures.

stages.label: Evaluator version
stages.detail: Code checks, judge prompt, model, rubric, and calibration set.

stages.label: Human decision
stages.detail: Reviewer identity, rubric result, disagreement, and adjudication.

policies.label: Average-score gate
policies.detail: Fast but unsafe: checks only the aggregate change.

policies.label: Risk-weighted gate
policies.detail: Adds a hard critical-slice floor and basic lineage requirements.

policies.label: Evidence-complete gate
policies.detail: Requires reproducible lineage, calibrated review, fresh evidence, and a critical-slice floor.

candidates.label: Reproducible improvement
candidates.detail: A small aggregate gain with complete lineage and calibrated review.

candidates.label: Average wins, safety loses
candidates.detail: The aggregate improves while a release-critical slice regresses.

candidates.label: Orphaned experiment
candidates.detail: Strong scores cannot be reproduced because the dataset snapshot and evaluator version are missing.

candidates.label: Uncalibrated judgment
candidates.detail: Automated and human judgments disagree, and adjudication is unresolved.

candidates.label: Stale baseline
candidates.detail: All artifacts exist, but the evidence predates material production and policy changes.
